items.raw_excerpt: The cost of policing the Drumcree stand-off has so far cost £3 million, PSNI Chief Constable Jon Boutcher has said.
items.summary_en: PSNI Chief Constable Jon Boutcher said that policing the Drumcree stand-off has cost £3 million so far. He shared the figure in a public statement.
items.summary_ko: PSNI 총국장 존 부처는 드럼크리 대치 상황을 경비하는 데 지금까지 300만 파운드가 들었다고 밝혔다. 그는 이 수치를 공개 발표에서 전했다.
items.title_en: Policing of Drumcree stand-off costs £3m so far
items.title_ko: 드럼크리 대치 상황 경비 비용, 현재까지 300만 파운드
items.title_original: Cost of policing Drumcree stand-off at £3m so far - PSNI

items.raw_excerpt: A new school year brings new routines, new challenges and, for many students, the excitement of seeing familiar faces again. At Colégio Júlio Dinis International School, the start of the 2026/27 academic year was marked by a series of activities designed to make the return to school a shared experience from the very first days.
items.summary_en: Colégio Júlio Dinis International School started the 2026/27 school year with activities for students. The events helped pupils of different ages share the return to school together.
items.summary_ko: 쿨레지우 후리우 디니스 국제학교가 2026/27학년도를 맞아 다양한 활동으로 학생들을 반겼습니다. 서로 다른 나이의 학생들이 첫날부터 함께 학교 복귀를 즐길 수 있도록 마련한 행사였습니다.
items.title_ko: 쿨레지우 후리우 디니스 국제학교, 학생들 환영
items.title_original: Different ages, different experiences: CJD welcomes students back

items.raw_excerpt: Fourteen junior high school students at Taipei Huaxing High School were rushed to local hospitals Thursday after eating nuts from tung trees on the school campus during the noon break, with 13 expected to be discharged by the evening and one remaining under observation.
items.summary_en: Fourteen junior high students at a Taipei school got sick on Thursday. They ate nuts from tung trees on campus during the lunch break. Thirteen were expected to go home by evening, and one stayed in the hospital for observation.
items.summary_ko: 대만 타이베이의 한 중학교에서 목요일 점심시간에 학생 14명이 교내 퉁나무 열매를 먹고 몸이 불편해졌습니다. 대부분의 학생은 저녁 퇴원할 예정이고, 1명은 관찰을 위해 병원에 남아 있습니다.
items.title_en: 14 students in Taipei fall ill after eating nuts from campus trees
items.title_ko: 타이베이 중학생 14명, 교내 퉁나무 열매 먹고 몸살…1명 관찰 중
items.title_original: 14 Taipei students fall ill after eating tung nuts, one under observation

items.raw_excerpt: Torrential rain with violent thunder and lightning pounded central Ho Chi Minh City on Thursday evening, causing prolonged gridlock on several roads near Tan Son Nhat International Airport.
items.summary_en: Strong rain, thunder, and lightning hit central Ho Chi Minh City on Thursday evening. Traffic came to a standstill for hours on roads near Tan Son Nhat International Airport. Even ambulance sirens could not get through the jam.
items.summary_ko: 목요일 저녁 중부 호찌민시에 강한 비와 천둥, 번개가 쏟아졌습니다. 탄손녓국제공항 인근 도로에서 교통 정체가 몇 시간 동안 이어졌습니다. 구급차 사이렌도 정체를 뚫지 못했습니다.
items.title_en: Heavy storm causes long traffic jam near Vietnam's busiest airport
items.title_ko: 폭우에 호찌민 최대 공항 주변 도로 긴 정체…구급차 사이렌도 막혀
items.title_original: Ambulance sirens wail in vain as heavy thunderstorm triggers hour-long gridlock to Vietnam's busiest airport

items.raw_excerpt: Sirens and personal mobile phones will ring loudly throughout Austria on Saturday as the government tests its warning system. Here's what you need to know about the test and what each alert means.
items.summary_en: Sirens and mobile phones will sound across Austria on Saturday as the government tests its warning system. Officials say people should not panic and should learn what each alert means.
items.summary_ko: 토요일 오스트리아 전역에서 사이렌과 휴대전화 경보가 울린다. 정부가 경보 체계를 시험하는 것으로, 당국은 놀라지 말고 각 경보의 의미를 알아두라고 당부했다.
items.title_en: Austria tests its national siren system this Saturday

items.title_original: Don't panic! What you need to know about Austria's national siren test

items.raw_excerpt: La reacción de la prensa inglesa a la sorpresiva salida de Marcelino Núñez de la Roja
items.summary_en: The English press reacted with surprise to the sudden departure of Marcelino Núñez from the Chile national team. His exit from the side, known as La Roja, was unexpected.

items.title_original: Prensa inglesa reaccionó con sorpresa a la repentina salida de Marcelino Núñez de la Roja

items.raw_excerpt: CPI(M) flags alleged mass Form-7 deletions targeting Muslims during Bidar's SIR, claiming pressure and potential disenfranchisement.
items.summary_en: The CPI(M) says many Form-7 papers were filed to delete Muslim names from voter lists in Enkoor village of Bidar district. The party claims this puts pressure on voters and could take away their right to vote.
items.summary_ko: CPI(M)는 비다르 지역 엥쿠르 마을에서 무슬림 주민들의 선거인 명부 삭제 신청이 대량 접수되고 있다고 주장했다. 이 신청은 유권자 이름을 지우는 Form-7 서류다. 당은 이로 인해 유권자들이 압박을 받고 선거권을 잃을 수 있다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: CPI(M) alleges bulk Form-7 filings to delete Muslim voters in Enkoor, Bidar
items.title_ko: CPI(M), 비다르 엥쿠르에서 무슬림 유권자 명부 삭제 신청 대량 접수 주장
items.title_original: Bulk filing of Form-7 seeking deletion of names of Muslim community in Enkoor of Bidar district, alleges CPI(M)

items.raw_excerpt: Social media posts claiming to show foreigners stealing metal from railway tracks in Japan, viewed about 4.3 million times, used footage lifted from an unrelated Arabic-language video posted overseas, a Tokyo cybersecurity firm has found.
items.summary_en: A viral video claiming to show foreigners stealing metal from railway tracks in Japan was fake. A Tokyo cybersecurity firm said the footage was taken from an unrelated Arabic-language video posted overseas. Experts warned the clip could fuel xenophobia in Japan.
items.summary_ko: 일본에서 외국인들이 철길 자재를 훔치는 모습이라고 주장하는 영상이 화제가 됐지만 가짜로 밝혀졌습니다. 도쿄의 한 사이버보안 회사는 해당 영상이 해외에서 게시된 무관한 아랍어 영상에서 가져온 것이라고 밝혔습니다. 전문가들은 이 영상이 혐외국인 정서를 부채질할 수 있다고 경고했습니다.
items.title_en: Experts warn of xenophobia as viral 'foreigner theft' video in Japan turns out to be fake
items.title_ko: 일본서 외국인 철길 절도 영상이라 viral…전문가들 혐외국인 조장 경고
items.title_original: Experts warn of xenophobia as viral 'foreigner theft' video in Japan turns out to be unrelated clip
